question: Is the food offering required to include mung beans, rice, and similar items?
premises: A food offering is given afterwards.
It may be accompanied by mung beans, rice, and so forth.
The particles na vā indicate this accompaniment is optional.
inference: The food offering may optionally include mung beans, rice, and similar items.
plain_english: Afterwards one should offer food, either accompanied by mung beans, rice, and so forth, or not.
